query:
SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.workspaceType FROM workspaces w ORDER BY w.createdAt;
SELECT br.id, br.workspaceId, br.status, COUNT(dc.id) as conceptCount 
FROM bot_runs br 
LEFT JOIN books b ON b.runId = br.id 
LEFT JOIN design_concepts dc ON dc.runId = br.id 
GROUP BY br.id, br.workspaceId, br.status 
ORDER BY br.id DESC LIMIT 10;
